title: Pack a phone charger kit
safety_rules: The adapter stays unplugged from the wall socket

steps.instruction: Plug the USB cable fully into the adapter.
steps.success_criteria: The cable's plug is pushed all the way into the adapter's port; no metal of the plug is visible.
steps.why: A half-inserted plug charges slowly or not at all, and customers return it as faulty.
hazards: Keep the adapter unplugged from the wall

common_mistakes.visual_cue: metal of the USB plug visible outside the adapter's port

steps.point_hint: the USB port on the adapter

vi.instruction: Cắm cáp USB vào hết cổng của củ sạc.
vi.why: Cắm hờ sẽ sạc chậm hoặc không sạc, và khách hàng sẽ trả lại vì lỗi.

hi.instruction: USB केबल को एडैप्टर में पूरी तरह लगाएँ।
hi.why: आधा लगा प्लग धीरे चार्ज करता है या बिल्कुल नहीं, और ग्राहक इसे खराब मानकर लौटा देते हैं।

steps.instruction: Coil the cable and hold the coil with a rubber band.
steps.success_criteria: The cable is wound into loops and one rubber band holds the loops together.
steps.why: A loose cable tangles in the box and gets damaged in shipping.

common_mistakes.visual_cue: cable lying straight or in loose loops with no rubber band around it

steps.point_hint: the middle of the cable coil

vi.instruction: Cuộn cáp lại và giữ cuộn bằng một sợi dây thun.
vi.why: Cáp để lỏng sẽ rối trong hộp và dễ hỏng khi vận chuyển.

hi.instruction: केबल को लपेटें और लपेट को रबर बैंड से बाँधें।
hi.why: खुली केबल डिब्बे में उलझ जाती है और भेजते समय खराब हो जाती है।

steps.instruction: Stick the label on the flat side of the adapter.
steps.success_criteria: A label is stuck flat on the adapter body, not on the cable.
steps.why: The label carries the serial number; on the cable it falls off and the unit can no longer be traced.

common_mistakes.visual_cue: label wrapped around or stuck on the cable instead of the adapter

steps.point_hint: the flat side of the adapter

vi.instruction: Dán nhãn lên mặt phẳng của củ sạc.
vi.why: Nhãn có số sê-ri; dán lên cáp sẽ dễ bong và không truy xuất được sản phẩm.

hi.instruction: लेबल को एडैप्टर की सपाट सतह पर चिपकाएँ।
hi.why: लेबल पर सीरियल नंबर होता है; केबल पर लगाने से वह गिर जाता है और यूनिट का पता नहीं चलता।
